Property Overview

A rare opportunity to fully restore a traditional West Cork farmhouse.

While the farmhouse requires complete renovation, it offers an exciting opportunity to create something genuinely special. Its traditional character, peaceful rural setting and generous site provide an ideal foundation for a comfortable family home, countryside retreat or holiday property.

Set on approximately 0.5 acres, the property retains an abundance of period features and enjoys views towards Curraghlicky Lake.

Outbuildings and Services

Several outbuildings are attached to the farmhouse. One has already undergone improvements, including the installation of a new roof, plastering, first-fix electrical wiring and a stove.

A new septic tank has been installed. However, the electricity supply has not yet been connected to the ESB network, and a water supply will also need to be installed.

Location and Amenities

The property is approximately a five-minute drive from the village of Drinagh, which offers a supermarket, hardware store, church, school and pubs.

The towns of Dunmanway and Skibbereen are each approximately 20 minutes away by car.

General Disclaimer / Important Notice

Interested parties should satisfy themselves fully regarding the condition, title, boundaries, planning status, services, fixtures, fittings and all other matters relating to the property before entering into any contract.

The property, lands and outbuildings are offered as seen. No warranty is given by the vendor or selling agent regarding their condition, suitability, use or future development potential.

Viewing is strictly by appointment only. No unauthorised access is permitted to the dwelling, lands or outbuildings. Please contact Irish Rural Homes using the contact details provided in this listing to arrange a suitable viewing time.
